name: warren-buffett-brain
description: Open-source, source-linked Warren Buffett and Berkshire Hathaway investment research for ChatGPT: real decisions, investing principles, historical mistakes and Buffett-inspired stock analysis.

interface.longDescription: Independent, source-linked Warren Buffett and Berkshire Hathaway research, bundled for ChatGPT as an evidence-led skill. Study real decisions, historical mistakes, moats and cash-flow reasoning; challenge stock-investment theses. The research works without any dedicated server, account, or ValuEdge connection. Optional external financial-data tools may help with dated valuations and screening. No live quote feed, brokerage access or Buffett endorsement.
capabilities: Study documented Berkshire Hathaway decisions with primary-source links
Analyze moats, owner-like cash flow and management stewardship
Challenge valuations and investment theses with counterarguments
defaultPrompt: Why did Buffett invest in GEICO? Use primary-source links and challenge the interpretation.
Analyze the moat, owner earnings and risks of a business I name, using Buffett-inspired principles.
Where did Buffett make costly mistakes, and what can investors learn from the original record?
